notes.title: Weekend Playtest April 25-27!
notes.content:
Happy Easter, my dear Electricians!
Today I bring you a chocolate egg full of info on our next playtest.

April Playtest begins Friday April 25th, 14:00 CET / 08:00 ET
We aim to run the servers for 44 hours, with the end time being Sunday at 10:00 CET.
Servers located in NA and EU will be available.

We will begin granting access to players April 24th (for those still waiting in the Steam Playtest queue).
If you already have access to the game since the last playtest, just update the game and jump in when matchmaking starts!

If you apply after the playtest started, we will try to let you in periodically.
You'll get an email from Steam letting you know that you are in!

IF YOU WANNA PLAY WITH YOUR FRIENDS, HAVE THEM REQUEST ACCESS ON OUR STEAM PAGE!

What's New / Changed?


Hero changes for:

- Rickshaw
Now has much more Health than the rest of the cast (about double) to make up for his size.
New Passive: You revive downed allies 50% faster and doing so grants you Shield chunks.
New Primary ability: Shoots a grappling arm that pulls enemies or allies to you.

- Koji
New Passive: Respawns 5 seconds faster.
Changed Primary ability: Now acts like an impact grenade and leaves a pool of flames on the ground that deals damage over time.

Changed Ultimate: Now launches a fireball in a straight line that gradually slows down. Press Ultimate button again to active the fireball, stopping it in mid-air and exploding it after a brief charge period.

- Crow
Changed Ultimate: No longer forms a dome of crows - AoE radius is smaller but more damage is dealt over a shorter amount of time.

- Jazz
New Passive: Jazz now has increased mantling height, making her able to reach ledges and vault up in places other characters can't.

Primary ability buffs: Flatlining an enemy refreshes 1 charge of her Dash.

Ultimate buffs: The invisibility is now more effective, activates faster, gives Jazz a movement speed boost and lasts several seconds longer.

- Ava
Changed Primary ability: Harpoons no longer deal damage to Health, only Shields.

- Prodigy
Ultimate nerfs: Players now have more time to escape the Disco area before the irresistable urge to dance kicks in.
The Disco ball now has a hurtbox and healthbar, meaning it can be shot and destroyed to end the Ultimate early.

New character shader applied to heroes

Gunplay has been tweaked and balanced
Bullet speed and effective weapon ranges have been increased.
Bullet drop has been reduced across the board.
Lower movement penalties and improved general accuracy (including hit reg calculated by the netcode).
Some well-deserved buffs to Sandman and Stingray.
TTK balancing pass across all combat ranges.

All of this should make the gunplay feel ~crisp~ and appropriate for our high-movement, arcade-y game!

Movement and magnet tweaked
Inertia is now properly preserved while moving and sliding.

Assignments have been removed

NEW Arena Center: Aztec

City and Moon Arena Centers have been updated

Big chests (now called Armory) has been moved from team bases into the center
The Armory chests now contain tons of loot and are more impactful in turning the tide of a match, meaning the decision to fight for one should not be made lightly.

Small chests have been removed

Magnet points and metal objects have a new shader.
We heard a lot of feedback that magnet points were difficult to see, so they are now much more blue and have this grid-like texture over them to help stand out from the rest of the map.

Updated wayfinding and notification UI
You will see more icons on the screen pointing you towards Hearts and Armory objectives.
Bigger text notifications will appear whenever a game event like a Heart spawn or a Heart plant happens as well.

Energy system tweaking and balancing
The Energy economy has been further tweaked to make the match flow better.
Plant zones now have a visual cooldown after being used before a Heart can be planted there again.

Removed AI voices and implemented real VO for heroes
Voice acting loving supplied by various dev team members (we are not professionals but we had a lot of fun doing it ːsteamhappyː)

Updated VFX on hero abilities, Heart plant and the final showdown Dome

Updated animation on hero abilities and character movement

Updated audio for notifications, menu navigation and character movement

Updated sky visuals

Changes to pickups
Flatlined enemies will sometimes drop ammo.
The highest ranking team will now have a chance of dropping Super Shields when flatlined.
Energy essence is now automatically picked up when walking close to it.

New advantages for the team in the lead
Burglar Alarm - be alerted when people are in your base.
Zipline from your spawn room into the Pancake.

Reworked shields - now shield strength is tied to team rank.

Loadout Mods have been strengthened.
We've been hard at work balancing weapons and mods, so if you've played with us before, make sure you re-evaluate your loadouts when first jumping in.

Known Issues

Heart pickup UI can disappear occasionally, but Heart can still be picked up with the assigned button.

Some rare crashes with specific GPUs still occur - if you crash, please reach out for support in our Discord.

Looking forward to seeing everyone on the field!
Make sure to join our Discord to stay updated on all the latest

/Groove, Community

notes.title: February Developer Update / Changes and Teasers
notes.content:
Hello all you Electricians out there! What's shaking?
Please enjoy your new affectionate nickname.

Groove here, back at it again in the Steam news trenches to give you a pretty hefty Development Update Jumbo Deluxe.

I’ll be touching on what we have been doing, what's happening to the game based on your feedback and what brand-spanking-new content is coming as development continues into the year.

So let’s jump from the battle bus right into it, shall we?


January Playtest Retrospective

As you may have seen, we held our first playtest as Heart Electric a few weeks ago.
Now that we're back to developing the next version of the game and digesting all your feedback, here's a little retrospective on the event.

To start with - It's no exaggeration to say that this was our biggest gathering of players so far.
We saw over 750 unique players in the game, with 143 peak concurrent players and over 60 matches run to completion.

We had quite a few livestreams covering the playtest from players and creators, like high-ranking Valorant player CaMbCaMb and FPS Vtuber group EVE.EXE!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206979/583f0096c6f2bfda6b30b0560a1b17e8260e2b02.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206979/d1d821971015a69a2986b16449ad8423d51e1c96.png

Everyone had a blast learning how to navigate and what’s possible mechanically in the game. Twitch chats were on fire whenever someone got dunked, and sounded very intrigued about what we are making!

The most played hero was - to no one's surprise - Jazz, with Koji not far behind.
We received a lot of feedback on these two for how to balance power levels, so thank you for that.

All of which is to say, we’re super happy with the result and stability of the playtest!
Humble beginnings, as they say.
We're only just getting started but a good start doesn't hurt.

Moving on, I want to address the valid frustrations that arose around January 18th.

We’ve heard your feedback on playtest timing and communication, especially the challenges of balancing optimal play times between North American and EU regions, and we’re committed to improving with clearer playtest information and better solutions.
Your support and constructive feedback is invaluable to our game’s development, and we deeply appreciate you being part of this journey. Stay connected with us by following our socials, joining our Discord and signing up for emails to avoid missing future communications regarding playtests.

Now back to the exciting stuff!


What are we changing/adding next?

Based on everyone's feedback and experience during the January playtest, allow me to talk about some of the changes that we are working on RIGHT👏THIS👏VERY👏SECOND!


Gunplay:
We are looking at more forgiving gunplay for players on the move, giving you better control while in motion and more opportunities to land those sweet drive-by and peek shots.

We are also making changes to some guns (Sandman, Stingray, Ram) to bring them a bit closer to the others. So expect bullet speed and general effective ranges of weapons to change.

Ultimate Abilities:
We will do a pretty significant balancing pass on Hero ultimates, giving all characters the situations to shine that they deserve!

Game HUD and UX:
There's quite a lot of UI functionality and other objective information that we didn't get into the January playtest build.
These will help players more clearly read the state of the match and make quick decisions.

How we clearly communicate gameplay objective information will receive a lot of focus as we move forward, as it’s extremely core to our game mode.

The Smart Ping used to mark enemies and see their status will be improved and be less finicky.
The damage indicator will be made clearer, with some audio additions, to make it really obvious when you are TAKING or DEALING damage.

The in-game compass at the top of the screen will be upgraded to display various information and objectives at a glance:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206979/0bae9e4841016e4c7c14906294379977d68fbe8a.png

Visuals and Performance:
More placeholder environments are continuously being replaced with proper assets, and the arenas will just look nicer in general as development continues.

We have started updating the character shading for every Hero. This does a bunch of technical stuff behind the scenes, but basically makes everyone look nicer in the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206979/14779faa343971c479b15d264623f09f26ff2865.png

Performance will also improve as we continue to optimize our assets, and we hope to see a steady improvement with every future playtest in terms of FPS.

Our netcode is being improved (using dark programming witchcraft I don't understand), making the overall gameplay experience on normal and high ping better.

Energy and Loot:
We are also looking into changing Shield functionality, Energy economy, and how Loot works. Expect the flow of the game to feel much better when we’ve implemented all this!


You might not see all of these things present in the very next playtest, but all of this (and more!) is coming. We know what needs to get done, but it takes a lot of time.

We just want to be transparent and show you exactly what is being worked on, and that we take your feedback very seriously.

When we say that Heart Electric is all about community-driven development - we mean it.

There were of course topics of feedback from you all that are not mentioned in the above list.
We have digested these as well, and rest assured that more changes are in the works that will be introduced later in the year as development continues.


Teasers of coming things

On that note, we have new stuff on the way that you can see and touch and it will have textures and AUUGHH CONTENT!!!


 A new center Pancake area, featuring some interesting-and-definitely-historically-accurate statues...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206979/8daa716b469c6eb4fa9847d21ee586444d505cfe.png


 Several heroes... (Silhouettes is all you're getting for now hoho~)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206979/316252c735ec7d045089443b6e4414a383019829.png


 More weapons...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206979/ea239c6c8a99ae739a123328b103424ee97a43ac.png


And we are giving characters new voice lines to bring them to life!⚡

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206979/6b626d1ba16011c1b128ff0caf8e94d16cf4051e.jpg

That's about it for today!
Once again - we're super grateful to all of you for reading and supporting us in all your little ways.🩷

If you have any other questions about what we're working on, or just some cool feedback ideas then jump in our Discord and let us know!

I shall see you all on the flip side - peace out!

/Groove, Community

notes.title: Winter Playtest is STARTING NOW!
notes.content:
🩷 THE FUN STARTS NOW! ⚡

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206979/667038ba8495efcefe0a86e919a8691680014993.png

After much anticipation, it's finally time for you to jump into some Heart Electric action with thousands of other eager testers...

📢 Important Information Regarding Playtest Times!
Servers go live and matchmaking starts at 18:00 CET.


If you have requested access to the playtest on our Steam page, we will start granting access in groups at 16:00 CET, which will continue up until 19:00 CET. So keep an eye on your email for your invite from Steam.

For anyone requesting access after 19:00 CET, we will still grant access as requests come in, all the way until 2 hours before the playtest ends.

🎥 You are free to stream/record gameplay as much as you want - the more hilarious clips for the world to see, the better!


Whats new in this version?


 Custom Loadouts are now available. Please make sure to select your Mods while making the loadout or else your loadout will not save. Custom Loadouts can currently not be re-named.
 There are now two Hearts, a normal Heart and a super Heart. A super Heart can be filled up to 20 Energy, while the normal Heart caps at 10 Energy.
 You can now drain other teams with Hearts once the Heart is empty. Plant them at another team’s base to take from their Energy reserve, then bring the Heart back to your own base to gain Energy!
 Assignments are objectives that show up on the top right side of your screen. Your team starts the match with one and you can find others in chests. Complete them to gain energy.
 New Hyper weapon: RAM - a powerful grenade launcher. 
 New primary weapon: Kraken - a light machine gun with a large magazine. 
 New primary weapon: Stingray - an assault rifle.
 New Character: Prodigy - Give others the urge to dance with her Ultimate, which stuns players and locks them in an excruciatingly stylish dance trance. Scan the area with her ‘F’ ability to ping enemies.
 "New" Character: Crow - Take to the skies and glide freely using his 'F' ability, and unleash an orb of AoE damage with his Ultimate.
 Astronaut's Moon base got a makeover! 
 The map is smaller and more concise than the one during the summer playtest.
 Players can now be banned, beware! 
 Essence drops when players are flatlined. Pick up Essence to get Ultimate charges. 
 Regions can now be selected by clicking on the Wi-Fi looking icon on the lower right side of your Lobby screen. You can select your closest region there.
 North America is now recognized by the Synths - expect lower ping if you are from this region and experienced issues during previous tests.
 Text chat has been implemented - Talk to and scheme with other teams to give yourself an edge. If you are caught abusing chat with harassment or NSFW content, you will be banned.
 Magnet no longer throws objects and causes collision damage. (RIP bonk kills) Instead, hold objects for a few seconds and aim them at other magnetic objects and let go to magnetize them together.


Known Issues


 You are currently unable to re-join a match in progress if you should get disconnected or quit for any reason. (We want to make this work ASAP for future playtests)
 If you get a matchmaking status saying “please manually select a region” or "NoValidRegions", please select your region manually instead of it being set to Automatic. You can find the region selector in the lower right of your Lobby screen, and it looks like a Wi-Fi bar symbol. Click on the button to open the region select.
 If no regions are available, press Ctrl+R to refresh your menu screen.
 If you have party issues, Ctrl+R refreshes your menu screen, which will help in a lot of cases. If players do not show as in-game but on Steam, you should still be able to invite them.
 Changing graphic settings while in a match can cause textures to disappear. If you are playing on a less powerful machine, please change graphics settings from the main menu instead to avoid this. If you lose textures, they should return the next match!
 Some rare crashes with specific GPUs - if you crash, go to support.
 Sometimes (rarely) a Heart might get stuck - this is on our radar to fix ASAP as well!
 During long bursts (over 30 bullets) the Vesper weapon will start to fire very close to vertical. 
 Loadout text can act weird with different localizations. If you see weird words in loadouts it will be due to this. 
 Prodigy’s pistol is not silenced as intended.

🔥 If this is your first time playing and you are still confused about our game, peep our updated How to Play video for this playtest to learn how our new Game Mode works! 🔥

[previewyoutube=3V67OCGT_3c;full][/previewyoutube]
That's about it! We really hope you have a great time playtesting Heart Electric, and that you're able to share your honest thoughts with us in our Discord!
See you on the battlefield soon, and try not to kick our developer butts too hard <3

/Groove

notes.title: OPEN PLAYTEST STARTS JANUARY 18TH
notes.content:
📢 WHO'S READY TO TEST SOME HEART ELECTRIC?
We're almost ready to welcome y'all into Silicon Hope as our first public playtest kicks off.

[previewyoutube=LhUE6ys50_8;full][/previewyoutube]

We have added some meat to the bones of the Energy game mode and we're super excited to hear what you think!
To briefly mention some new stuff: there will now be Assignments to complete that will earn your team Energy, on top of being able to steal Energy from other team's bases. (see the video further down and you'll understand <3)

There will be 6 characters available for testing, with Crow and Prodigy joining the fray for the first time.
Some of our finest work if I do say so myself...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206979/89c0dfaf2342548bd6d365da6fdd54d730a9b459.png
Loadout Customization is HERE, so you can finally build your perfect gun and perk combo for maximum shenanigans.
8 guns, 3 Hyper Weapons, 14 player perks and more gun mods than you can shake a stick at.

There's a lot more to cover in terms of changes since last playtest, so we'll have a dedicated Patch Notes post in January to really get into the nitty gritty.

📢 Playtest Dates and Times
Here's everything you need to know:

 Saturday, January 18
 Starting 18:00 CET / 09:00 PST (EU and NA timezones)
 Servers will be up for 6 hours minimum, but will likely be extended if everything is going swimmingly ✨
 Further communications will be posted in our Discord  as the playtest is happening, so make sure you and your crew all join to not miss anything. ːsteammockingː

Want to make sure you get to playtest?
Well, the title says it all, doesn't it?
Just make sure that you've opted into playtests by clicking the buttom here on our Steam page, and everyone will get an invite when January 18th rolls around.

The more people we get to playtest, the more fun you will have in the queues and the more feedback we can get to improve the game faster. So recruit your friends and schedule in a Heart Electric Saturday Bonanza, and tell your streamer friends to check us out as well!

[previewyoutube=pG6mCAVEYlQ;full][/previewyoutube]
Seriously though. We have been waiting eagerly to have everything ready for this playtest, and we can't wait to see the biggest group of playtesters yet jump into the action.

From the entire HE team, thank you for waiting just a little longer.
See you all again very soon, and Happy Holidays!

I'M TALKING BRAND NEW SPACE ROCKS!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206979/290778fea3689f4958f1e7fc81928d3ed4e40b8d.jpg

notes.title: Welcome to Heart Electric / Upcoming Playtest
notes.content:
Hello world! After a long time of hush-hushing and secret playtests, we can finally share Heart Electric with the world. You can join our Discord to see how development is coming along and sign-up to our next playtest right here on Steam.

[previewyoutube=Zkh-3GQ6fSs;full][/previewyoutube]

So what is Heart Electric all about, and why are we making it? The game takes the form of a 4-team elimination FPS where our Energy mechanic decides the winner. Set in 2068, Heart Electric immerses you in a world where sentient AI battle for freedom. You’ll be able to customize your own loadout of various weapons and perks, and pair those up with any of our synthetic heroes.

Our whole Modoyo team strongly believe that the new mechanics, emergent gameplay with creative tactics, and a strong emphasis on teamplay makes Heart Electric into something really cool and fresh for the genre.

We want to give a huge thank you to our amazing batch of playtesters who've helped steer us in the right direction so far. We have much more to experiment with and reiterate, and we’re excited to from now on bring many new playtesters into the fray of feedback. That means YOU!

[previewyoutube=nYE92P63jQ8;full][/previewyoutube]

 FEEL THE PULSE, BEAT THE ODDS - Heart Electric emphasizes teamplay like no other FPS, with 12 other players as opponents you wield the Flux, an electromatic power that allows you to interact with any metal around you! 
 TEAMPLAY AT THE CORE - Teamplay is the Heart of Heart Electric. Planning your moves and striking at the right time can mean the difference between elimination and winning. You will need to leverage everything you have against your opponents in order to come out on top.
 BUILD YOUR APPROACH - With a varied roster of heroes, and a plethora of loadouts for you to create and experiment with, Heart Electric enables you to customize your playstyle to be as effective as possible. Every match offers a unique opportunity to showcase your strategic ingenuity in an FPS.
 DEVELOP WITH THE COMMUNITY - When we say we want your feedback, we mean it. We are a small and passionate team and we want to make your next favorite FPS! You can sign up to playtest, follow and wishlist on Steam! Our Discord is a hub for feedback, so you can make your mark on the game as well as chat with us about anything you’re curious about as we continue with our development.

UPCOMING PLAYTEST

Click the "Request Access" button on our Steam Store page to sign up for our first major playtest, happening later this year. Drop us a follow to get alerted as soon as we post more information about it!

Thanks for reading, catch y’all soon.

/Groove

FOLLOW US

Check our other social channels below to stay up-to-date on all things Heart Electric, and head to our official Discord.
